{{Quote|Coruscant Space Traffic Coordination on link here. Our files show you're transporting exotics? Our scan shows you have eight individuals on board.|A Traffic Coordinator|<ref name="WedgesGamble" />}}
'''Coruscant Space Traffic Coordination''' was the government office under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that was charged with monitoring and clearing all [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] entering or leaving the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="WedgesGamble" />

According to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax Terrik]], certain members of the office had been paid to allow a clear entry for [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] runners heading to certain brothels at the edge of the [[Alien Protection Zone/Legends|Invisible Sector]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] used this loophole to enter Coruscant, eventually [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|seizing]] the planet from the Empire.<ref name="WedgesGamble" />
